name: Datum Sim
tagline: Model and simulate dynamic systems: block diagrams, control and motors.
for: Control, mechanical, electrical, process and mechatronics engineers, researchers and students.
about: Datum Sim models and simulates dynamic systems. You draw the system as blocks and wires: sources, transfer functions, state space, PID controllers, motors and lookup tables. Then press Run and watch the signals on live scopes.

Five solvers cover everything from simple fixed-step runs to stiff systems; the variable-step solvers find switching times exactly. Parameter sweeps run in the app's own engine, step-response specifications and Bode plots come from a built-in Python engine, and the solvers and main blocks are checked against known answers.

steps.title: Draw the model
steps.text: Drag blocks from the library, wire them together and set their parameters.

steps.title: Run
steps.text: Choose a solver and a stop time, press Run and watch the scopes live.

steps.title: Analyse and tune
steps.text: Sweep parameters, read the step-response specifications and tune the controller.

highlights: Draw a model as blocks and wires, press Run and watch live scopes
About 45 blocks: sources, math, transfer functions, state space, PID, delays, discontinuities, lookup tables
DC motor and permanent-magnet synchronous motor blocks, with worked speed and position control examples
Subsystems: group blocks into one, open them, nest them
Five solvers, from fixed-step Euler to variable-step and stiff; the variable-step solvers find switching times exactly
Parameter sweeps, plus step-response specifications and Bode plots from the built-in Python engine
The solvers and main blocks checked against known answers
